scenarios.name: fresh guest startup requests only public config
observations: no /api/sync*, no /api/auth/me, no personal endpoints before login
two GET /api/config per guest load, 56ms apart (both public, authenticated=false)
in this build the unauthenticated surface is the entry login screen; no separate guest shell UI was found (WebAuthGate renders LoginScreen(asEntry: true) when no saved identity)

scenarios.name: saved login cold start: config before personal sync, no settings visit, no 120s delay
observations: all startup requests complete within 0.84s of reload; no 120s delay and no settings visit needed
config precedes POST /api/sync; sync carries the authenticated fixture token
profile reads (workspaces, mentions, auth/me) precede config on cold start; second /api/config (unauthenticated header) fires 58ms after the first
login itself issued POST /api/auth/login then config(auth) + auth/me + workspaces, POST /api/sync 2.68s after login

scenarios.name: direct entry to statistics: no false admin-closed, config in flight shows loading, ready state allows generation
observations: ai_enabled=true: entering statistics issued one GET /api/config and the AI action stayed enabled with no admin-closed hint
config_hold=true plus statistics entry produced 'Loading AI configuration…' with the AI action disabled; screenshot captured ~1s into the hold
the hold was released later than the client's 8s timeout, so the panel moved to 'Could not load AI configuration. Check your connection and try again.' with an in-place Retry action
Retry after clearing the fault fetched config again and restored the enabled AI action; the generate control was never clicked

scenarios.name: cloud-sync card forces config then sync, double click coalesces, spinner/disabled restore

requests.note: single fetch despite two card clicks 0.4s apart while config_hold=true
exactly one data sync after release

observations: held state text 'Cloud sync Syncing…' with the card rendered non-interactive; restored to 'Synced / Last synced Nov 1 12:20 PM' after release
second click during the hold produced no additional GET

scenarios.name: config failure vs recovery, sync-card failure does not fake success
observations: config_fail=true: one GET /api/config with fixture_failed=true produced 'Could not load AI configuration. Check your connection and try again.' and a Retry action; no admin-closed text
Retry after config_fail=false produced a second GET /api/config that succeeded and restored the enabled AI action
sync_fail=true: config succeeded then POST /api/sync failed, card showed 'Sync failed 503: Fixture sync temporarily unavailable Will retry automatically' (no success state, no new last-sync time)
entering statistics inside the 30s success window issued zero config requests, confirming cache reuse rather than refetch

scenarios.name: admin AI disabled only after successful config, history stays reachable, restore true
observations: ai_enabled=false with a successful GET /api/config showed 'An administrator must enable AI before a cloud insight can be generated' and no connection error
AI insight history screen opened with heading 'AI insight history' and the current-week period filter while AI was disabled
after ai_enabled=true and cache expiry, the hint disappeared and the AI action was enabled again
no legacy history entries were seeded; the history list was empty in this fresh session

scenarios.name: manual sync failure then retry recovers
observations: retry after sync_fail=false produced config then sync and the card returned to 'Synced / Last synced Nov 1 12:23 PM'

scenarios.name: light default surface screenshots at 1280x1000 and 390x844 without overflow
observations: 7 screenshots at 1280x1000 and 2 at 390x844
console contained no RenderFlex overflow entries while resizing to 390x844 and navigating statistics and settings

counts.resetsPerformed: counts reset between scenarios; pre-reset snapshots saved in scratch as startup-sync-e2e-*-pre-reset.json

limitations: one config hold exceeded the client's 8s timeout before release, so that panel transitioned from loading to failure; the loading text and screenshot were captured inside the first second
guest mode in this build has no separate shell surface; the measurable guest claim (public config only, no personal/sync requests) is what was verified
two GET /api/config per page load were observed; recorded as fact, not asserted as a defect
business-level manual verification only; no native install, no real model, no production host
screenshots are light default theme at 1280x1000 and 390x844; dark theme and 320px are out of scope for this run
credentials: isolated fixture account (archive-preview) only; token is the fixture value; not reproduced in this report or in this JSON
